entries.name: cell
entries.inexpressible: cell is 24. The cells are 24 on a side and the motif runs from x -24 to 384 and y 0 to 192. scale about the center at 12 puts that motif at x 78 to 282 and y 48 to 144, so the stage edges are bare. repeat copies the whole grid and does not set the pitch. The future kind is pitch re-tiling. It keeps the stage covered from half to double and changes only the pitch.

entries.name: angle
entries.inexpressible: angle is 45. The first run of the motif is 22 by 22, so the slope is 45 degrees, and that slope is baked into the path. The motion is translateX. A rotate turns the whole motif. The future kind changes the slope and leaves the scroll.

entries.name: gap
entries.inexpressible: gap is 22. The motif is 170 dots on a 22 pitch, each of radius 3.4. scale changes the dot and the gap together. repeat copies the whole motif. The future kind changes the pitch and leaves the dot.

entries.name: gap
entries.inexpressible: gap is 32. The cells are 32 on a side. scale changes the mark and the gap together. repeat copies the whole grid. The future kind changes the pitch and leaves the stroke.

entries.name: spacing
entries.inexpressible: spacing is 24. The dots sit on a 24 pitch. scale changes the dot and the spacing together. repeat copies the whole motif. The future kind changes the pitch and leaves the dot.

entries.name: stops
entries.inexpressible: stops is 2, and gradient s0 and s1 are already drawn. repeat copies a layer. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: layerCount
entries.inexpressible: layerCount is 3, and far, mid, and near are already drawn. repeat copies one layer. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: speed
entries.inexpressible: speed is 7. The motif travels 28 px over 120 frames at 30 fps, which is 7 px/s. retime moves that key later when the value grows, so the same travel takes longer. The future kind shortens the cycle as the speed grows.

entries.name: angle
entries.inexpressible: angle is 45. A stripe edge runs 18.4 by 18.4, so the slope is 45 degrees, and that slope is baked into the path. A rotate turns the whole motif. The future kind changes the slope and leaves the scroll.

entries.name: amplitude
entries.inexpressible: amplitude is 14. One wave runs from y 14 to y 42, so the half-range is 14, and that height is in the static motif. The keyed motion is translateX. The path has one key, so amplitude changes nothing. scale changes the height and the wavelength together. The future kind changes the wave height and leaves the wavelength.

entries.name: viewAngle
entries.inexpressible: viewAngle is 12. The lid runs from x 64 to 256 at y 14 and from x 58 to 262 at y 96, so the lower edge is 12 wider. The screen ink has the same extra 12. offset writes rotate beside translate(-40 0), and the settle animateTransform replaces the group transform with a translate, so the lid does not turn. The future kind is a lid taper. It changes the upper span and leaves the lower edge.

entries.name: bezel
entries.inexpressible: bezel is 12. The body runs from x 118 to 202 and y 16 to 164. The screen ink runs from x 130 to 190 and y 28 to 152, an inset of 12 on each side. The ink is not a track. scale of attr.d multiplies the body and leaves the screen, so a doubled value doubles the body instead of making the inset 24. The future kind sets that inset and leaves the outer body.

entries.name: rotation
entries.inexpressible: rotation is -6. The card's right edge runs from 205.03, 20.92 to 218.41, 148.21, 6 degrees from vertical. offset writes rotate beside the settle translate, and the settle animateTransform replaces the group transform, so the card does not turn further. The future kind is a center turn. It turns the card about its center by the difference from -6, in the same direction as this lean, and keeps the settle slide.

entries.name: battery
entries.inexpressible: battery is 80. The fill runs from x 235 to 248.6, a width of 13.6, and the inner cell from x 235 to 252 is 17 wide. 13.6 is 80 percent of 17. That fill is one part of the ink path. scale changes the whole bar, including the time. The future kind sets the fill width to that percent of the cell and leaves the cell.

entries.name: bezel
entries.inexpressible: bezel is 16. The body runs from x 72 to 248 and y 26 to 154. The screen ink runs from x 88 to 232 and y 42 to 138, an inset of 16 on each side. scale of the body leaves the screen, and a doubled value does not make the inset 32. The future kind sets that inset and leaves the outer body.

entries.name: maxWidth
entries.inexpressible: maxWidth is 142. The glyph path runs from x 89 to 231, width 142, and from y 100 to 164, height 64. Uniform scale changes the height with the width. The future kind is a single-axis scale.

entries.name: exaggeration
entries.inexpressible: exaggeration is 0.29. Every painted key ends at y 120 while the top moves, so the pop grows about the baseline. The rest pose is x 111 to 209 and y 78 to 120. overshoot at 0.145, at 0.29, and at 0.58 compiles to the same SVG, because these poses are not one scale about the rest box center. scale and amplitude grow the rest pose as well. The future kind is baseline-anchored overshoot. It multiplies only the growth past the rest pose about the baseline and leaves the rest pose.

entries.name: stops
entries.inexpressible: stops is 2, and gradient s0 and s1 are already drawn. repeat copies the text. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: speed
entries.inexpressible: speed is 203.75. The line travels 163 px over 24 frames at 30 fps, and 163 / (24/30) is 203.75. retime moves that key later when the value grows, so the same travel takes longer. The future kind shortens the cycle as the speed grows.

entries.name: speed
entries.inexpressible: speed is 4. The reveal steps at frames 6, 10, 14, and 18, so the later gaps are 4 and the first gap is 6. retime at double moves the clip to frames 0, 12, 20, 28, and 36, including the first step. The future kind is hold. It keeps the first step and scales the later gap.

entries.name: leading
entries.inexpressible: leading is 36. The columns jump from x 142 to x 178, a gap of 36. tracking is the vertical gap of 12. scale changes the glyphs with the column gap. The future kind changes that gap and leaves the glyphs.

entries.name: columnCount
entries.inexpressible: columnCount is 4, and 4 columns are already drawn. repeat copies one. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: hole
entries.inexpressible: hole is 36. The ring is one path with outer radius 68 and inner radius 36. scale multiplies both radii. The future kind changes the inner radius and leaves the outer radius.

entries.name: phases
entries.inexpressible: phases is 4, and 4 phases are already drawn. repeat copies that path. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: minimum
entries.inexpressible: minimum is 0, max is 100, and value is 75. The hub is at 160, 118. The last needle sits 45 degrees above the horizontal, which is 75 percent of the half-circle from the left. scale and amplitude move that needle. They leave the left end as the origin. The future kind moves the scale origin and keeps the hub.

entries.name: cells
entries.inexpressible: cells is 12, and four bands of three cells are already drawn. repeat copies a band. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: slices
entries.inexpressible: slices is 3, and s0, s1, and s2 are already drawn. repeat copies one slice. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: count
entries.inexpressible: count is 6, and 6 dots are already drawn. repeat copies that path. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: points
entries.inexpressible: points is 8. The line is one path through x 48, 80, 112, 144, 176, 208, 240, and 272. repeat copies that path. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: segments
entries.inexpressible: segments is 3. The bar is one path, and the fill is three bands on gradient s0 through s5. repeat copies the bar. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: value
entries.inexpressible: value is 72. The digits are a path. replace would write the number into attr.d. The future kind redraws the digits.

entries.name: events
entries.inexpressible: events is 4, and d0 through d3 are already drawn. repeat copies one mark. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: seed
entries.inexpressible: seed is not a fixed axis

entries.name: barCount
entries.inexpressible: barCount is 12, and bar0 through bar11 are already drawn. repeat copies a bar and shifts the copy, which changes the golden. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: wordTime
entries.inexpressible: wordTime is 8, the interval between words on a 30-frame loop. The words rise at frames 3, 12, and 21. word2 holds until frame 18. stagger keeps the loop key, so at double that rise clamps to frame 30 and the word never rises. The future kind is lyric spacing: it grows the loop length, or the spacing between words, with the interval, and every word still rises.

entries.name: bandCount
entries.inexpressible: bandCount is 16, and band0 through band15 are already drawn on the arc. repeat copies a band and shifts the copy, which changes the golden. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: pointCount
entries.inexpressible: pointCount is 48, and the waveform is one polyline of those points. repeat copies that shape. It does not resample the line. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: center
entries.inexpressible: center is the point 160 90. A point p renders at C + s(p - C). Moving the center by D moves the content by (1 - s_f) * D. The zoom runs from scale 1 to 1.24, and this parameter does not declare that per-frame factor, so a point offset is the wrong sign and the wrong magnitude. The future kind is pivot.

entries.name: antennaCount
entries.inexpressible: antennaCount is 2, and lantenna and rantenna are already drawn. repeat copies one antenna and shifts the copy, which changes the golden. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: tail
entries.inexpressible: tail is 3, and tail0 through tail2 are already drawn as one chain. repeat copies a segment and shifts it off that chain, which changes the golden. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: sparkle
entries.inexpressible: sparkle is 3, and spark0 through spark2 are already drawn. repeat copies one spark and shifts the copy, which changes the golden. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: proportion
entries.inexpressible: proportion is 1.2, width divided by height. The arms run from x 116 to x 204 and the body from y 78 to y 152, about 88 by 74. Uniform path scale multiplies both axes, so that ratio stays. The future kind is a single-axis scale.

entries.name: proportion
entries.inexpressible: proportion is 1, width divided by height. The body runs from x 130 to x 190 and from y 80 to y 136, 60 by 56. Uniform path scale multiplies both axes, so that ratio stays. The future kind is a single-axis scale.

entries.name: proportion
entries.inexpressible: proportion is 0.76, width divided by height. The body runs from x 134 to x 186 and from y 74 to y 142, 52 by 68. Uniform path scale multiplies both axes, so that ratio stays. The future kind is a single-axis scale.

entries.name: teeth
entries.inexpressible: teeth is 4, and four teeth are already drawn in the teeth path. repeat copies that path and shifts the copy, which changes the golden. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: mechanicalTiming
entries.inexpressible: mechanicalTiming is 2, and each pose is keyed every 2 frames. retime multiplies every key frame and slows the whole walk. The future kind is hold.

entries.name: looseTiming
entries.inexpressible: looseTiming is 8, the arms' lag. The arm paths and the clavicle share frames 0, 3, 15, and 24, so the arms stay on the shoulders. retime of the arms moves those keys and leaves the shoulders. The future kind is lag, and the arms stay attached.

entries.name: coat
entries.inexpressible: coat is 8, the fur's own swing. amplitude scales the fur's whole deviation, including the walk the fur rides on. At 16 the fur detaches from the head. The future kind is fur-local deviation, secondary motion. It is not amplitude and it is not the time-shift lag.

entries.name: start
entries.inexpressible: start is 0. It remaps the pose from this frame to endFrame. endFrame is already retime and multiplies every baked key. retime of start has no factor when the anchor is 0. stagger keeps a begin of 0. Changing start from 0 to 12 changes the compiled picture. The future kind moves the window start and leaves endFrame's keys.

entries.name: depthRatio
entries.inexpressible: depthRatio is 0.6. The compiler sets the far travel over the near travel. The compiled subject-f0 box moves 30.25 px while ground-f0 moves 50.22 px, ratio 0.60. projected-offset uses that ratio as a gain. It does not set the ratio. The future kind sets the far travel divided by the near travel.

entries.name: strength
entries.inexpressible: strength is 16. The translate keys are absolute, and the pose does not read strength. The subject center at frame 0 is 160.23, 88.23. The largest leave from that rest is frame 3, 17.62 away. Strength 8, 32, and 48 leave that displacement unchanged. The future kind scales that displacement about the unshaken rest and holds the rest.

entries.name: layer
entries.inexpressible: layer is 2. One cloud is drawn. speed is already retime. repeat copies that cloud rather than choosing a layer. The future kind selects the layer.

entries.name: petalCount
entries.inexpressible: petalCount is 6, and the petals path already has 6 petals. repeat copies that path. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: density
entries.inexpressible: density is 8, and b0 through b7 are already drawn. repeat copies one blade. The future kind is a layout-regenerating count.

entries.name: phase
entries.inexpressible: phase is 0.65. The path is a crescent with outer radius 34 and inner radius 22, and 22/34 is 0.647. The only track is opacity 0.85, 1, 0.85. amplitude of that fade does not change the crescent. scale keeps the ratio of the radii. The future kind changes the inner radius and leaves the outer radius.

entries.name: density

entries.name: arcCount

The translate stays 0 then 224. The future kind is a vertical wave-height scale. The repeat spacing stays fixed.
